verdicts.reason: A: the skates are cropped hard at the top edge, losing the hanging laces from the original. Decorative rings collide with the skate toe and blade, and 'ICE' almost touches the blade tip. Even so, the code block is evenly spaced around its divider and the CTA sits centered below it, so the hierarchy holds. B: several rings land on top of the white boots, an obvious unwanted collision. The code block is cramped, with the divider jammed against 'USE CODE' and 'TO GET A DISCOUNT'. The headline, code block and CTA don't share one axis, and the left half of the canvas is mostly empty.
